why: Bank Robbery MV round 6, rap to camera: RUST alone, a garage full of lacquered getaway cars, on "Stacks and stacks of elastic cash"
prompt:
A 1920s feature-film frame on 35mm. The mask and suit are exactly as in the attached reference image; only RUST is in the shot, his mask copied exactly from its close-up: rust-gold rib-knit wool over the whole head, no holes, a white wool ring round the face, one small rounded red felt triangle high over his left eye, on the right of the picture. Black double-breasted suit, white tie, black leather gloves, cuffs over the wrists, collar up. In a garage of lacquered maroon sedans with freestanding headlamps, RUST leans over a car's long hood, glaring up into the lens, frozen at the bottom of a flat-palm chop, his gloved palm landing edge-down across a neat stack of banknote bundles bound in elastic bands. A mechanic's legs stick out from under the car on a creeper, unbothered. Close, low, 28mm lens at hood level. Lit only by one caged bare bulb hanging above, glaring on the lacquer; beyond it, inky shadow. 16:9.

Thanks.
